description: Sherpa voice WASM bundle smoke test (web)

wait-wasm-ready.expression: (function(){return new Promise(function(resolve){var i=0;function tick(){if(typeof window.SherpaOnnx==='object' && typeof window.SherpaOnnx.ASR==='object' && typeof window.SherpaOnnx.ASR.loadModel==='function'){resolve({ready:true,asrKeys:Object.keys(window.SherpaOnnx.ASR),topLevelKeys:Object.keys(window.SherpaOnnx)});return;}i++;if(i>=120){resolve({ready:false,reason:'timeout',i:i});return;}setTimeout(tick,500);}tick();});})()

verify-bundle-symbols.expression: (async function(){function getWasmBase(){var s=document.querySelector('script[src*="_expo/static"]');if(s&&s.src){try{var u=new URL(s.src);var i=u.pathname.indexOf('_expo/static');if(i>0)return u.pathname.substring(0,i)+'wasm/';}catch(e){}}return '/wasm/';}var url=getWasmBase()+'sherpa-onnx-wasm-combined.wasm';var r=await fetch(url);var buf=await r.arrayBuffer();var text=new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:false}).decode(new Uint8Array(buf));globalThis.__wasmSmokeResult={url:url,sizeBytes:buf.byteLength,hasCohere:text.includes('cohere-transcribe'),hasQwen3:text.includes('qwen3-asr')};return globalThis.__wasmSmokeResult;})()
